# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-10-20 from the 2026-10-20 Hub dump.

- 3,169,657 models tracked, 899,263 declare a base model, 932,203 parent links, 88,446 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
